description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms.

features.name: Druidic
features.tldr: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids, and can use it to leave hidden messages.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: You can cast divine nature spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.tldr: Magically assume the shape of a beast you have seen before twice per short rest.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.tldr: Choose a mystical circle that shapes your connection to nature and wild shaping.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.tldr: Your Wild Shape improves to allow swimming beasts.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Druid Circle Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Druid Circle.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.tldr: The magic of nature grants you slow aging, so you suffer none of the frailty of old age.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.tldr: You can cast many of your druid spells while in your wild shape animal form.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement

features.name: Archdruid
features.tldr: You can use your Wild Shape an unlimited number of times, and can use verbal/somatic components without material limits.
